baseline: LoteDiretor Brasil Blueprint Final v2.0, Section 32 prevails

target.app_shell: fixed rail + global search + workspace/date-base head + full-width task-focused content
target.map: MapLibre GL + deck.gl baseline; Martin MVT from PostGIS
target.api: NestJS modular monolith + Fastify Adapter + Mercurius REST/GraphQL
target.workers: Python for ETL, geospatial engines, AI/solvers
target.data: PostgreSQL/PostGIS source of truth + immutable snapshots + evidence lineage
target.auth: Keycloak OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE; HttpOnly/SameSite cookie/BFF
target.deploy: Docker local; CI/CD staging→canary→prod; Terraform; Kubernetes only when justified

current_state.notes: Five first-wave cities have live parcel resolvers plus growing national context, provenance registry and regression smoke.
Registry/audit/coverage exist and source-id consistency test exists; immutable raw snapshots are only partial.
Public dossier persistence/hash exists, but every connector/result is not yet represented as source_id+snapshot_id+parser_version evidence.
Municipality SIDRA context plus exact 2022 census-sector point-in-polygon for first-wave cities.
INCRA/SIGEF public spatial refs, FUNAI, SICAR public property geometry; SNCR/CCIR/CAFIR/CIB authenticated flows remain.
ANA, ICMBio, SGB, MapBiomas and several municipal layers live; IBAMA/INPE/ANM national layers still missing.
Municipal road layers where available, DNIT and cached Overpass context live.
Production client is a static HTML app with Leaflet 2D and isolated MapLibre 3D. Blueprint requires React/Next.js and MapLibre/deck.gl; Leaflet out of baseline.
Pitched MapLibre urban view and building extrusion exists; no unified terrain/building/scenario engine in Three.js/Cesium yet.
Operational API is Python http server. No NestJS/Fastify/Mercurius platform API/BFF yet.
Martin MVT baseline not yet serving the first-wave Explorer.
No Keycloak OIDC cookie/BFF production shell yet.
Municipal zoning/parameters exist unevenly; no full versioned legal engine/OpenSearch hybrid corpus yet.
Responses can be persisted, but no final immutable Analysis Run freezing all input snapshots/rules/calculations/findings.
Browser print/PDF exists; no canonical server Report Engine producing PDF/DOCX/JSON from a frozen Analysis Run.
systemd/logs and smoke tests exist; no OTel traces, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki/SLO suite.
GitHub/versioned deploy scripts exist; no signed artifact canary pipeline/Terraform baseline yet.

Create apps/api NestJS/Fastify/Mercurius façade with versioned contracts over existing Python resolvers; Python becomes engine/worker layer.
Introduce Martin MVT for parcel/zoning/high-volume layers and migrate 2D map to MapLibre/deck.gl.
Create evidence/snapshot contract for every field and freeze Analysis Run objects.
Create canonical Report Engine PDF/DOCX/JSON from Analysis Run.
Add Keycloak/BFF auth, tenant entitlements and private-data boundaries before any authenticated registry integration.
Add OpenSearch legal corpus + temporal rules/evidence.
Add OTel/metrics/logs/SLO, CI/CD canary/rollback and Terraform.
Replace isolated 3D PoC with Three.js/Cesium terrain/building/constraint/scenario workspace.
